name: Preferred key
responsibility: Sign with an SSH agent key, such as a YubiKey PIV key, when the agent can.
description: prefer.pub beside the machine key records the preference. Signing runs ssh-keygen -Y sign -U with a 30-second limit and accepts only a clean exit and a signature by that key. Any failure falls back to the machine key, and a one-line notice goes to /dev/tty, because git hides the stderr of a signing program that succeeds. Through the agent, a cancelled PIN, an unplugged YubiKey and a stale PKCS#11 session look the same, so the preference is best effort.
